title: Fifthback Semantic Model
description: Machine-readable companion to ontology.md. Descriptive of the meaning already encoded in backend/server.py and frontend/src/{data,lib}. Not imported or executed by the application.

language_policy.rationale: The product speaks Turkish; a translated ontology drifts from the copy the user reads.

commitments: Fifthback models friction in a work system, not people.
No Person entity exists at any layer.
A claim may only assert what a verbatim quote supports.
Things cluster by mechanism, not by shared words.
An unmeasured dimension stays null and is displayed as unmeasured.

Anlati.definition: What a person said in their own words, in one sitting. The only legitimate home of verbatim employee language.

Sinyal.definition: One evidence-bearing observation: a short neutral label plus the exact span of the Anlati supporting it.

evidence.constraint: verbatim substring of the parent Anlati

Sinyal.naming_hazard: The word 'sinyal' denotes three different things in the codebase. See ambiguities.md section 1.

HavuzSatiri.definition: An already-anonymous single-sentence statement in the Pattern Room pool: the 24 seeded examples plus anything a manager appends.

pool_index.note: cluster membership is by index, which makes the pool append-only in practice

HavuzSatiri.relation_to_signal: closer to a miniature Anlati than to a Sinyal

Mekanizma.definition: The structural reason a set of statements co-occur. A claim about how the work system behaves, not a topic label.
Mekanizma.extension_rule: PATTERN_ROOM_PROMPT permits defining a new mechanism when the evidence does not fit an existing one.

Kume.definition: A set of Pool Lines bound by one mechanism. Engine-side object; decides membership.

Hikaye.definition: The human-facing face of a Cluster: a sentence an employee would actually say. Presentation only; never decides membership.
Hikaye.fallback_rule: Unknown cluster falls back to the backend's own name; a title is never invented.

Oruntu.definition: A cluster promoted to organisational attention, carrying mass, spread, age and status.
Oruntu.note: The two shapes are not interchangeable; lib/pressure.js has a separate adapter for each.

Sikisiklik.definition: A derived reading over a Pattern. Coverage is part of the reading, not metadata.
rules: Weights renormalise over present components only.
Absent components stay null and render as 'Yeterli veri yok'.
POSITIVE or RESOLVED patterns are not reported as friction.

EtkinIhtiyac.definition: A need the text supports, held co-actively with other needs.
EtkinIhtiyac.hard_rule: Never presented as an A-vs-B dilemma. The relation catalogue has no exclusivity edge.

Sorumluluk.definition: Two lists, organisational and personal, phrased as possibility rather than blame.

Kanal.definition: A possible next step with an honest trade-off attached.
Kanal.safety_rule: Confronting a manager may never be the only channel offered.

AyirtEdiciSoru.definition: The single question that would most change what the feedback means, asked only when it would change it.

stop_reason.note: a first-class outcome, not a failure

Temellendirme.definition: A check on whether a refined interpretation is still supported by the person's own words.

when_failed.note: required; a case with no failure mode is a slogan

Eylem.definition: A tracked, falsifiable intervention against a Pattern.

Yayginlik.definition: Whether an interpretation matched a real seeded pattern, and that pattern's real numbers. Never synthesised.
Yayginlik.no_match_behaviour: found=false and an honest empty state

Kisi.reason: No identity, no stable pseudonymous id, no department, age or gender.

impact.source: qualitative word in estimated_cost | presence of blocker

speaking_cost.status: declared as a manager axis but never measured; see ambiguities.md section 4

relations.name: refines
relations.constraint: may downgrade a claim, never invent one

forbidden_relations.name: excludes
forbidden_relations.reason: Needs are co-active; forcing a dilemma is a golden-rule violation.

forbidden_relations.name: caused_by
forbidden_relations.reason: Causality between two statements is not extractable from a single text.

mechanisms.test: Is the work waiting on a decision that exists but has not been made? If the decision has been made and is merely unknown, it is bilgi-boslugu.
Would the work move if one named party accepted it? If it would still not move because no one knows what to decide, it is karar-gecikmesi.
Does the loss happen at the boundary between two teams, at the moment of transfer? Continuous ambiguity is belirsiz-sahiplik.
Was finished work redone? If it was never finished because it kept waiting, it is karar-gecikmesi.
Structural only: work routed to a team without the capability. Never applied to an individual.
mechanisms.risk: The one mechanism that can slide into judging people; see ambiguities.md section 6.

mechanisms.test: Would more hands actually move it? If adding people has already failed to help, it is onceliklendirme-catismasi.
Does the needed fact exist somewhere but cannot be found? If it does not exist yet, it is karar-gecikmesi.
Is the same output produced twice in parallel? Sequential redoing of one output is yeniden-is.
Is everyone busy while specific work sits untouched? That separates it from kapasite-kisiti.
Does the friction persist after the information is found, in moving it between systems? Otherwise bilgi-boslugu.

c5.name: Bilgi & Araç Kopukluğu
c5.mechanism_string: bilgi boşluğu + araç/sistem sürtüşmesi + süreç tekrarı
c5.story_title: Bilgi dağınık, aynı şeyi elle taşıyoruz.

P0.name: birinci ağızdan iç kaynak
P0.definition: The person's own words, typed or spoken into the product by them.

P1.name: aktarılan iç kaynak
P1.definition: Anonymous lines entered on someone else's behalf: manager-pasted signals, workshop notes, retro exports.
P1.caveat: Wording is the relayer's, so it cannot support a verbatim-evidence claim.

P2.name: örnek / demo
P2.definition: The 24 seeded pool lines, dictionary phrases and seeded manager patterns.

P3.name: dış kamusal kaynak
P3.definition: Publicly posted statements about work life originating outside the organisation.

D1.name: anonim havuz
D1.visible_as: part of a cluster, never alone

D2.name: yönetici görünümü
D2.rationale: a manager already knows who reports to them, so the bar is higher

D3.name: dışa açık
D3.requires: P2 or P3 provenance, or a paraphrased aggregate above every threshold

privacy_thresholds.note: These numbers are duplicated here for reference. privacy.js is authoritative; if the two disagree, privacy.js wins and this file is stale.

gating_rules.rule: A signal may never be disclosed above the maximum class its provenance permits.
P0 content reaches D1 only by an explicit act of the author.
P3 external signals may inform mechanism vocabulary and hypotheses but must never contribute to any frequency, prevalence or mass count.
P2 demo content must be visibly labelled wherever it is shown alongside real content.
Any breakdown with a non-empty bucket below MIN_BUCKET_N is suppressed entirely, so a complement cannot expose a minority of one.
Displayed provenance is paraphrased and requires at least MIN_PROVENANCE_N contributing signals.

invariants.rule: Signal.evidence is a verbatim substring of the Anlati.
invariants.failure_looks_like: a quote appears that the person never typed

invariants.rule: Needs are co-active; never an A/B dilemma.
invariants.failure_looks_like: the UI offers mutually exclusive needs

invariants.rule: No person is modelled, scored or diagnosed.
No fabricated statistic, benchmark or currency figure.
invariants.failure_looks_like: a number appears with no engine field behind it

invariants.rule: Aggregates are gated by anonymity thresholds.
Displayed provenance is paraphrased, never verbatim.
invariants.failure_looks_like: a real employee sentence is shown to a manager

invariants.rule: Unknown input falls back to the engine's own name.
invariants.failure_looks_like: an invented title appears for an unmapped cluster

invariants.rule: POSITIVE and RESOLVED are not reported as friction.
Unmeasured dimensions stay null and say so.
invariants.failure_looks_like: a guessed value fills a gap
the board can only ever confirm

invariants.rule: No channel requires confrontation as the only path.
invariants.failure_looks_like: the sole suggestion is to confront a manager

invariants.rule: Interventions are offered as precedent, not prescription.

employee_story.note: SHARED is a disclosure change, not progress.

manager_pattern.note: STUCK is the only state that increases pressure.

action_board.note: The only lifecycle with a disconfirming terminal state.

E0.name: tekil anlatı
E0.definition: One utterance. Sufficient to reflect back to its author; never sufficient to claim a pattern.

E1.name: tekrar
E1.definition: Several independent statements of the same mechanism inside one team.

E2.name: yayılım
E2.definition: The same mechanism appears in statements from unrelated teams.

E3.name: dış doğrulama
E3.definition: A P3 corpus shows the same mechanism elsewhere. Raises confidence in the mechanism's existence; adds no mass to this organisation's pattern.

E4.name: müdahale sonucu
E4.definition: An Eylem moved to RESOLVED or REJECTED with a recorded before/after. The only grade that can disconfirm.

open_gaps: Cost of speaking up is declared as a manager axis but never measured, and has no mechanism.
POSITIVE feedback has no positive mechanism vocabulary to cluster into.
There is no event log, so trend over time is not answerable.
Cross-organisation comparison is deliberately out of scope.
